content.text: {"id": "mm6914e3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 226 patients who met the inclusion criteria, 23% had positive test results for influenza."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "of those, nine (11%) had evidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "of those, nine (11%) had evidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "an estimated 8% (19 of 226) of persons seen at participating urgent care centers with respiratory symptoms had COVID-19"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Persons with positive test results for COVID-19 were adults with a median age of 46 years"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the median age was 31 years"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "during March 5–14, among patients with respiratory symptoms evaluated at one of four Santa Clara County urgent care centers serving as sentinel surveillance sites"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Because of limited testing capacity, a convenience sample of the first 5–10 specimens that tested negative for influenza virus each day"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "If it is assumed there were no influenza and SARS-CoV-2 coinfections"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": []}
